skill.summary: (已验证) 强大的抖音视频批量转写器，集成了下载、音频提取和本地 Whisper 模型转写功能。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of video-transcriber – a robust batch transcription tool for Douyin videos.

- Integrates video downloading, audio extraction (via ffmpeg), and local transcription using Whisper.
- Automates the workflow for converting multiple Douyin video links into text transcripts.
- Requires ffmpeg and TikHub API Token setup for full functionality.
- Outputs transcription reports as Markdown files, with support for batch processing.
- Command-line interface with flexible parameter options.
